headline: Natural Gas Plummets on Warm Forecasts While Brent Jumps on Oil-Driven Inflation Fears
paragraphs: Natural gas suffered a steep daily drop of 6.31 percent and a 14.22 percent weekly slide, driven by warm weather forecasts. WTI crude fell 3.70 percent as traders weighed a supply recovery against ongoing shipping risks, whereas Brent crude rose 1.13 percent. Platinum and palladium dropped 1.73 percent and 1.74 percent respectively, with the cause of these specific daily declines unclear from the available news.

Gold edged down 0.25 percent to EUR 3677.84, stabilizing near a one-week low as oil-driven inflation fears grow and yields pick up. The euro traded at 1.1236 against the US dollar, maintaining steady foreign exchange conditions for Irish import costs.
